name: Branstock Khalder
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Branstock Khalder guides dwarven priests in the Holy Light and watches the trogg threat beyond the outpost.

sections.title: A Guiding Hand in Coldridge
sections.body: At Anvilmar, Branstock Khalder teaches novice priests their first prayers and sacred runes. He guides them in the Light while troggs menace the local mountaineers. When a novice has learned enough, Branstock sends them through Coldridge Pass to Kharanos. There, they can seek further guidance from his superior, Father Maxan Anvol.

faq.answer: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Branstock Khalder trains young dwarven priests in the Holy Light and counsels them through the valley’s hardships.

faq.q: Where does Branstock send his students next?
aliases: where do i go after branstock
faq.answer: Branstock sends young priests through Coldridge Pass to Kharanos for further guidance from his superior, Father Maxan Anvol.

faq.q: What is Branstock concerned about in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Branstock is concerned about the growing trogg threat in Coldridge Valley and the danger it poses to local mountaineers.

faq.q: What does he say to non-priests?
faq.answer: Branstock advises you never to turn your back on the Light. Faith may save your life someday.

angles.text: As a priest, you meet Branstock Khalder as your first spiritual guide. He teaches you an initial sacred rune and introduces you to the healing and defensive arts of the Holy Light.
As a dwarf, you find in Branstock a practical devotion to the Light and resilience against the cold and trogg threat.
